notes: New in 0.22: Techies One Mail is now Techies One. Beside Mail: Albums (all your photos and videos by the date they were taken, slideshows, films, Looking back, names and words, and your Picasa stars, albums and captions brought across), Letters, Sums and Files. Mail gets your own folders, new email announced by the clock even with the window closed, and old emails brought in from Outlook, Windows Live Mail and Thunderbird. Contacts keep postal addresses and print envelopes and labels. Back up your email to a USB stick. Help on every screen, with a "How do I...?" search. Signed by 365 Techies Ltd.
